items.title: Groundbreaking rainforest conservationist Tony Parkes dies aged 96
items.description: After falling in love with Australia's ancient Big Scrub rainforest, Tony Parkes built his life around saving its final remnants and restoring hundreds of hectares.

items.title: Breaking: Search for missing girl after father's body found in Sydney bay
items.description: A desperate search is underway for a missing girl after a man's body was found in a bay in Sydney's inner west on Saturday.

items.title: Victorian opposition leader says Pauline Hanson has not approached her

items.title: Could Switzerland become the first country to restrict its population?

items.title: 'Lambo Guy' Adrian Portelli sues former minister over lottery comments
items.description: Melbourne "rewards club" lottery billionaire Adrian Portelli has launched a defamation lawsuit against former SA minister Andrea Michaels over comments she made about a $3.5 million home prize draw.
